ready_with_caveats still fits. The blocker text must change because an official MCP exists. It has plan-based action limits: 25, 50 and 100 per minute for Growth, Pro and Enterprise. API key is the only auth.

corrected.one_liner: Freshworks' cloud customer-support helpdesk for ticketing, contacts, SLAs, automations and knowledge base.
corrected.auth_notes: Personal API key sent via HTTP Basic (key as username, any placeholder as password). The API reference lists OAuth 2.0 scopes per endpoint (e.g. freshdesk.tickets.view), but no OAuth flow for third-party apps is described, so OAuth2 is not listed. The official MCP server also uses an API key in the Authorization header.
corrected.access_notes: 14-day trial, no credit card required. Trial API limit is 50 calls/min. The API key help article says the API key and API functionality are not available on the Sprout plan, and its table marks Free as unavailable. Paid plans (Growth/Pro/Enterprise) have API access. Rate limits are per plan with per-endpoint sublimits. The API page is inconsistent between per-minute and per-hour figures.
corrected.blocker: No free tier with API access: it needs a 14-day trial or a paid plan. Rate limits are plan-based with per-endpoint sublimits. The official MCP server is rate-limited by plan (25/50/100 actions per minute for Growth/Pro/Enterprise) and has yearly action quotas. It uses API key auth only, with no third-party OAuth flow, so users must supply their own API key and subdomain.
